parameters.query: SELECT ct.id, ct.title, ct.description, ct.municipality, ct.state, o.name as org_name FROM chat_threads ct JOIN organizations o ON ct.organization_id = o.id WHERE ct.id = {{ $json.thread_id }} AND ct.organization_id = {{ $json.org_id }} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, filename, mime_type, category, status FROM chat_files WHERE thread_id = {{ $json.thread_id }} AND status = 'processed' ORDER BY uploaded_at ASC

SELECT id, instruction_number, version, content_text FROM municipal_instructions WHERE municipality = {{ $('Load Thread Info').item.json.municipality }} AND state = {{ $('Load Thread Info').item.json.state }} AND is_current = true LIMIT 1
SELECT id, event_type, status FROM chat_timeline_events WHERE thread_id = {{ $json.thread_id }} ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1

parameters.columns: thread_id, event_type, title, description, status, event_metadata, event_date
